plan.title: Deploy it as a stack on the gateway, at auth.bendelhome.cc over HTTPS
plan.description:
The live gateway runs it like its other stacks, connected to the shared Postgres (its form's Shared services), which makes its database and role, behind its proxy with a certificate, at `auth.bendelhome.cc` (a Caddy connection, as the apps' addresses are), on the LAN and over Tailscale only, like tickets (chosen on AU-1). Passkeys need HTTPS and an address that doesn't change.

Settings, from building AU-1.1:

- The stack is named `auth` and its service `rauthy`, since the gateway hands Postgres in as `GW_rauthy__PG*`; the Caddy connection points at service `rauthy`, port 8080.
- `TRUSTED_PROXIES` is `shared-caddy`'s subnet, read on the machine. If that network is ever made again, every request is refused until it's updated.
- No mail relay for now (chosen on AU-1): `SMTP_URL` stays unset, so Rauthy writes its sign-in and reset links to its log, where you read one when you need it. A relay comes when a second person signs in.
- The image has no shell, so there's no healthcheck: a deploy counts on the container staying up through the gateway's 10-second watch.

It changes the live gateway, so it's yours to run.

plan.title: Check a restore from the nightly dump, and keep the encryption keys apart from it
plan.description: The shared Postgres dumps Rauthy's database each night, a week kept (chosen on AU-1), with its people, apps, agents and signing keys. The signing keys are stored encrypted with Rauthy's encryption keys, which live in the deploy's environment: without them a dump can't be read, so they're kept safe, and apart from the dumps. A restore is tried once, on a copy: a person signs in and an agent gets a token.

plan.description: The `auth` stack is on the live gateway since 2026-10-13, made from this repo's `main` with deploy on push off: its Postgres connection (database and role `auth`), its Caddy connection (`auth.bendelhome.cc`, port 8080), `TRUSTED_PROXIES` (`172.31.0.0/16`) and both `HQL_SECRET_*`, made by the gateway. Done from your gateway session, with your permission.

plan.title: Add items-core's console as Rauthy's app: sign-in by authorization code with PKCE, for its live and dev addresses
plan.description:
items-core's console is an OpenID Connect client (IC-21). Its sign-in returns to the console on the gateway (items.bendelhome.cc) or to its local dev address, and its tokens carry the person's verified email, which the console's admins list is keyed by.

Done 2026-10-16 in Rauthy's admin pages, from your signed-in Chrome with your permission. The client `items-console` (named "items-core console") is public, with no secret. Its flows are `authorization_code` with PKCE S256 enforced, plus `refresh_token`, since the console renews its tokens. Its redirect URIs are `https://items.bendelhome.cc/auth/callback` and `http://localhost:4220/auth/callback`; after sign-out it returns to `https://items.bendelhome.cc/` or `http://localhost:4220/`. Its allowed origins are `https://items.bendelhome.cc` and `http://localhost:4220`, since the console calls Rauthy from the browser. Its scopes are Rauthy's defaults: `openid`, `email`, `profile` and `groups` allowed, `openid` always. Its tokens are EdDSA. Rauthy's issuer is `https://auth.bendelhome.cc/auth/v1/`.
